image.subject: a damp empty stone prison cell on the Chateau d'If with a chained iron bed and a single barred window onto the grey sea, 1815

storyboard.claim: Dantes builds an inescapable prison for his enemies out of his own trauma.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The cell that will hold him, shown empty, as the stone he later turns into a trap.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opening hook, no earlier beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The cell is the origin of the revenge machine.

image.subject: a close-up of an open banker's ledger on a dark desk beside a blank bond certificate and a brass lamp, Paris 1830s

storyboard.claim: The revenge is run like finance, with a ledger and a blank check.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A ledger and a blank bond certificate side by side on a banker's desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the prison hook by naming the two tools.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the financial tools, not the prison.

storyboard.claim: This is a high-stakes financial thriller, not a swashbuckler.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only framing card carrying the genre reframe.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the ledger image into a genre claim.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, writing in a ledger by candlelight in a Paris study, 1830s

storyboard.claim: Revenge is a meticulous form of authorship.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count writing by candlelight, the pen as the instrument.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the framing card to the Count as author.
storyboard.addedInformation: Introduces the Count's look before his full name.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in a black frock coat with a bond certificate under his hand at a banker's desk, a brass lamp, Paris bond exchange office, 1830s

storyboard.claim: He writes fates the way a banker moves bonds: interest, leverage, foreclosure.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count's hand on a bond certificate at a banker's desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the Count at a desk, now with bonds.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the banking mechanics of revenge.

storyboard.claim: We must study the board before the pieces are flipped.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only card for the metaphor of a game board.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: A pause before the setting.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets the game metaphor for the story.

image.subject: Marseille harbour at dawn, a three-masted merchant ship moored at the quay, fishing boats, stone warehouses, 1815

storyboard.claim: The story opens in Marseille in 1815.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dawn harbour with a moored merchant ship.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Leaves the metaphor for the physical place.

image.subject: a crowd of sailors and merchants on a sun-bleached Marseille quay in 1815, tense faces, stone warehouses behind them

storyboard.claim: The sun-drenched port is buzzing with nervous energy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Crowded quay with tense faces under harsh sun.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Zooms from the harbour to its crowd.
storyboard.addedInformation: Atmosphere of unease before the arrest.

image.subject: a three-masted merchant ship, the Pharaon, moored at a Marseille quay at dawn, sails furled, 1815

storyboard.claim: The three-masted merchant ship, the Pharaon, arrives.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The ship at the quay.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the crowd to the ship they watch.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the ship (narration says Faron; it is the Pharaon).

image.subject: a lean dark-haired young sailor in his late teens, sunburnt face, plain sailor's linen shirt and dark trousers, stepping down a gangplank onto a Marseille quay, 1815

storyboard.claim: A brilliant, uncorrupted 19-year-old sailor steps off the ship.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dantes stepping onto the quay.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The ship becomes the man who leaves it.

image.subject: a lean dark-haired young sailor, sunburnt face, plain sailor's linen shirt, standing on a bright Marseille quay in strong sun, 1815

storyboard.claim: Dantes is so sun-soaked he seems to have swallowed the sun.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dantes in hard sunlight, face burnt by the voyage.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Stays with Dantes, closer on his face.

image.subject: an empty ship's captain's cabin at sea, a dark-blue coat folded on a sea chest, a lantern swinging, 1815

storyboard.claim: The ship's captain died during the voyage.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Empty captain's cabin with a folded coat, no body, no gore.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from Dantes to the loss that gives him command.
storyboard.addedInformation: The captain's death on the voyage; aftermath only.

image.subject: a lean dark-haired young sailor at the wheel of a merchant ship in rough grey sea, calm and steady, 1815

storyboard.claim: Despite his youth, Dantes takes command and brings the ship safely home.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dantes steady at the wheel.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the captain's death with Dantes in charge.
storyboard.addedInformation: His competence and the ship owner's impression.

image.subject: a grave young officer in a dark blue naval coat with brass buttons, fair short hair, shaking hands with a sunburnt young sailor on a Marseille quay, 1815

storyboard.claim: Shipowner Morrel is about to name the teenager the new captain.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Morrel and Dantes handshake on the quay.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the voyage to the reward.

image.subject: a dark-haired young Catalan woman in a simple pale 1815 dress with a shawl, dark eyes, waiting at a whitewashed fishing village doorway, the sea behind

storyboard.claim: Dantes is rushing to marry Mercedes in the Catalan village.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Mercedes waiting at a village doorway.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from the job to the love.
storyboard.addedInformation: Introduces Mercedes and the Catalan village.

storyboard.claim: Dantes has everything: youth, looks, the crew, the captaincy and the bride.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Four-item text list.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarizes the perfect life before it breaks.
storyboard.addedInformation: A real list of his assets.

image.subject: a sunlit Marseille quay where a young sailor in linen stands in full sun, a long dark shadow stretching across the stones behind him, 1815

storyboard.claim: That blinding perfection is exactly what destroys him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Full sun with a long shadow on the stones.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the list into the danger of light.

left.label: LIGHT
left.subject: a sunlit young sailor on a Marseille quay, arms open, sun on his face, 1815

right.label: SHADOW
right.subject: three men in dark coats standing together in the shade of a warehouse wall, watching him, 1815

storyboard.claim: His light casts three men into shadow and breeds resentment.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two-sided compare: sunlit sailor against three men in shade.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the envy as a contrast.
storyboard.addedInformation: Introduces the three conspirators as a group.

image.subject: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, neat side-parted hair, sallow cautious face, at a ship's ledger on a quay, 1815

storyboard.claim: Danglars, the ship's supercargo, is the first conspirator.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Danglars at his ledger.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the group to the first man.

image.subject: a handsome dark-haired young Catalan fisherman in a faded blue jacket, brooding, standing by a fishing boat on a Marseille beach, 1815

storyboard.claim: Danglars envies the captain job; Fernand Mondego is the brooding fisherman.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fernand by a fishing boat, brooding.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Danglars's envy leads to the second conspirator.

image.subject: a handsome dark-haired young Catalan fisherman in a faded blue jacket watching a dark-haired woman in a pale dress turn away on a whitewashed village street, 1815

storyboard.claim: Fernand is obsessively in love with Mercedes, his cousin, who friend-zones him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Mercedes turns away from Fernand on a village street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives Fernand's motive through a visible rejection.
storyboard.addedInformation: Mercedes's cousin relation and his obsession.

image.subject: a handsome dark-haired young Catalan fisherman sitting alone at a tavern table, a glass of wine untouched, jaw clenched, candlelit, 1815

storyboard.claim: She says she loves Dantes, and Fernand simmers with primal resentment.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fernand alone at a tavern table, jaw clenched.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues Fernand's rejection into anger.

image.subject: a sharp-faced middle-aged royal prosecutor in a black judicial coat with a white cravat, grey-streaked dark hair swept back, cold precise expression, Restoration France 1815

storyboard.claim: The final trap piece is Villefort, the 27-year-old deputy crown prosecutor.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Villefort in his black judicial coat.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Adds the third-level power to the plot.

image.subject: a sharp-faced royal prosecutor in a black judicial coat standing in a dark stone corridor, his long shadow thrown up the wall by a candle, 1815

storyboard.claim: Villefort is terrified of his own shadow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Villefort before his shadow on a wall.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Makes the shadow motif personal.

image.subject: a folded tricolour flag and a Napoleonic bicorne hat on a dusty wooden table in a candlelit room, 1815

storyboard.claim: That shadow is his father, a notorious Bonapartist.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tricolour and bicorne hat, the Bonapartist emblems.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the source of the shadow.

storyboard.claim: The politics of 1815 are the murder weapon, life or death.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only card for the stakes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: A beat of framing the politics.

image.subject: a map of the Mediterranean with the island of Elba circled in ink on a candlelit desk, 1815

storyboard.claim: Napoleon has been exiled to the island of Elba.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Map with Elba circled.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the political facts a place.

image.subject: a gilt royal throne in a candlelit Paris hall with a crown on a velvet cushion, dark wood panels, 1815

storyboard.claim: King Louis XVIII is back on the throne, and the royalists are paranoid.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Empty gilt throne with crown on velvet.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the exile to the restored king.

storyboard.claim: Being a Bonapartist is treason and can get you executed.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only card for the death risk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the danger of the father's label.

image.subject: a grey-haired older man in a worn 1815 imperial officer's coat at a candlelit Paris desk, a stern face, papers scattered, Restoration France

storyboard.claim: Villefort's father Noirtier was a massive player in Napoleon's inner circle.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Noirtier at a desk in an imperial coat.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the father in the Bonapartist circle.
storyboard.addedInformation: The father's role in Napoleon's court.

image.subject: a black-coated royal prosecutor dragging a heavy iron chain along a stone quay at dusk, 1815

storyboard.claim: Villefort builds a gleaming career while dragging a radioactive political anchor.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Prosecutor dragging a chain on the quay.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the father's history into a weight on the son.

image.subject: an anonymous folded letter on a dark desk beside a quill and a wax seal, candlelight, Marseille 1815

storyboard.claim: Danglars and Fernand write an anonymous letter accusing Dantes of being a Bonapartist agent.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Folded letter, quill and seal.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The conspirators' plot becomes the physical letter.

image.subject: a black-coated royal prosecutor seated across a candlelit table from a young sailor in plain linen, both leaning forward, a letter between them

storyboard.claim: The letter lands on Villefort's desk and he interrogates Dantes, a lit match in a powder keg.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Interrogation across a candlelit table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The letter reaches the man who will judge it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Dantes in the room with Villefort.

image.subject: a lean dark-haired young sailor in plain linen, hands open, earnest face, in a candlelit office, 1815

storyboard.claim: Villefort sees Dantes is innocent, a naive kid carrying a dying captain's letter.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dantes with open hands, innocent.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the innocence the prosecutor recognizes.
storyboard.addedInformation: The letter came as a favor from the dying captain.

image.subject: a close-up of a folded letter on a dark desk with a prosecutor's gloved fingertip resting on its edge, candlelight, 1815

storyboard.claim: The address is Monsieur Noirtier, Villefort's own father. This is the turning point.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letter edge under a gloved fingertip.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The innocence turns to self-interest.
storyboard.addedInformation: The letter is addressed to the prosecutor's father.

image.subject: a dark prosecutor's office with a small pile of grey ash in an iron tray and a black judicial coat hung on a chair, 1815

storyboard.claim: If the letter is found, Villefort's career is ash.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Grey ash in an iron tray.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The address creates the threat to his career.

image.subject: a folded letter catching fire in an iron grate, a black judicial coat over a chair, a candle on the desk, 1815

storyboard.claim: He burns the letter and buries the only man who knows.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letter burning in an iron grate.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The ash becomes the act.

image.subject: a grey stone fortress on a rocky island off Marseille at dusk, a guard boat at the jetty, 1815

storyboard.claim: Without a trial, Dantes vanishes into the Chateau d'If.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Grey island fortress at dusk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The burial becomes a place.

image.subject: a pitch-black prison cell interior, a thin ray of light from a barred window high on the wall, 1815

storyboard.claim: The Chateau is reserved for the most dangerous political prisoners; the cell is pitch black.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Black cell with one ray of light.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the fortress to the inside.

storyboard.claim: For years, Dantes sees nothing but stone: sensory deprivation.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only card for the years of stone.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Closes the chunk on the deprivation.
